text:
Maya (Marketing): Quick sync 
We need a social push for the benchmark release + webinar. KPI: signups and identify warm inbound. Proposed: X longform thread, LinkedIn carousel, 1 EMEA-friendly static. Need assets, final A/B copy, shortlink with UTMs, and SDR routing rules by Friday. Tagging: @Sam G (scheduling), @Priya R (copy), @Ollie (Design) (assets), @Ben - Growth (routing).

Sam G: I can schedule X for Mon 10am PT and LinkedIn at 11:30am PT. Prefer X first to drive thread engagement -> then LinkedIn. Confirmed tentative slots in calendar.

Priya R: Drafting two tones: immediate CTA and conversation-first. Samples: 
- Immediate: "See real inference savings in our benchmark. Join the webinar: https://rwd.in/bench-reg?utm_source=social&utm_campaign=bench_launch"
- Conversational: "Wondering how teams cut inference cost 2x+? We'll show the methodology + live Q&A. RSVP: https://rwd.in/bench-reg?utm_source=social&utm_campaign=bench_explore"
Suggest running both across channels as A/B.

Ollie (Design): I'll produce LinkedIn carousel (5 slides) and 3 X cards (hero + two crops). Plan: slide2 = micro-benchmark chart, slide4 = cost breakdown. Export target Fri 5pm PT. Any brand or copy callouts?

Ben - Growth: Routing plan: mark replies/clicks with campaign UTM as candidates. Rules: if reply contains "demo"/"pricing"/"quote" or a click + text length > threshold then create a HubSpot lead with property social_lead=warm and route to SDR queue "Bench-Warm". Also post a Slack alert to #sales-inbound.

Maya (Marketing): Ben 
Can you paste the webhook matcher so Eng can validate? Avoid dupes across channels (same email/handle).

Ben - Growth: Matcher pseudocode: 
```
if (utm_campaign == "bench_launch" && (reply_text.match(/demo|pricing|quote/i) || (clicked && message_text.length > 20))) {
  createHubSpotContact({source: "social", campaign: "bench_launch"})
  setProperty("social_lead", "warm")
  routeTo("Bench-Warm")
}
```
Will DM the prod webhook to Sam and add test mode.

Sam G: Scheduler (internal) supports click webhooks. We can include the shortlink and UTM in payload. If HubSpot needs specific fields, let me know.

Priya R: Thread opener idea: "Benchmarks you can act on: same model, different stack -> 2.3x cost delta. See the numbers + join the webinar." Will shorten with our shortlink. Also prepping short microcopy for quick bot replies.

Ollie (Design): CTA question: slide5 should be "Register" for launch. We'll switch to "Watch Replay" later for evergreen.

Maya (Marketing): Agreed. Also we need a follow-up DM flow for clickers who don't convert: 24h reminder, 3d nudge with a relevant case snippet, 7d final invite. Priya can draft the microcopy.

Priya R: DM sequence drafts: 
1) 24h: "Thanks for checking this out  spots filling up, grab a seat: <link>"
2) 3d: "Still thinking? Heres a short case blurb + webinar link"
3) 7d: "Final reminder  live Q&A + deep dive on the benchmark"
I'll tighten and localize for EMEA times.

social-bot: Scheduled: X thread (id: 999001122) -> 2026-04-06T17:00:00Z; LinkedIn carousel (id: 999001123) -> 2026-04-06T18:30:00Z; click_webhook=true.

Ben - Growth: Testing plan: run smoke click -> create test contact in HubSpot staging -> confirm Slack alert in #sales-inbound. If green, flip to prod webhook Mon AM. Also will dedupe by email/handle.

Maya (Marketing): One experiment: two immediate auto-replies on X. Reply A = webinar link. Reply B = qualifier: "Are you more interested in cost or latency? Reply with 'cost' or 'latency'." That will help intent mapping. Ben ok with routing?

Ben - Growth: Yep. Map keyword replies to HubSpot property intent={cost|latency}. Prioritize those for SDR outreach.

Priya R: Will draft the two bot replies.

Sam G: I'll post preview links (LinkedIn carousel preview + X thread draft) to this thread once ready. Also will include shortlink/GA parameters.

Ollie (Design): Uploading final PNG/SVGs to campaign folder after export and will ping here when complete.

Maya (Marketing): Action items: 
- Priya: finalize A/B copy + DM flow (Thu EOD)
- Ollie: export assets (Fri 5pm PT)
- Sam: scheduling + preview links (Fri 6pm PT)
- Ben: webhook & smoke test (Mon AM)

Maya (Marketing): Thanks all  reconvene Mon after smoke test. :rocket:
